```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 01_variables_where
title: Where do statistics come from?
questions:
  - id: where
    type: free-response
    checkLabel: Submit
    explanation: >
      There isn't one complete answer. Statistics are produced when somebody
      decides what to study, how to define and measure it, whom to collect data
      from, and how to summarize and present what they find.
```
